title.description: The commit subject: an imperative phrase saying what changed, Sentence case, about 60 characters. No prefix, no trailing period, no commit hash.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the reviewer: what was wrong, what the change does, and why that is enough. Specific to this change.

confidence.description: high = the edit removes the defect and nothing else depends on the old behavior. medium = it plausibly fixes it but a caller or a platform variant was not checked. low = a best attempt.

results.description: One entry per numbered finding you were given.

id.description: The finding's number from the list you were given.

outcome.description: fixed = this edit resolves it. not_fixed = you made no change for it.

note.description: For not_fixed: why. Omit for fixed.

not_verified.description: What you could not check here and a reviewer should - a build, a platform, a caller you did not open. Omit when nothing applies.
